eps.d: When confronted by a furious Lucas, Toadie struggles to believe Peter would be behind Chriss attack. However when the police ask Toadie to help with their enquiries, hes shocked to realise the full extent of Peters scheme. Toadies interviewed but doesnt have many answers for the strong case mounting against him.

Determined to clear his name, Toadie discovers that one of the forged emails used by Peter to frame him was sent while he was in a meeting with Paul. Despite the potential alibi, Toadie fears that, if Paul learns about the corruption, hell blow it in the papers.

Desperate to help clear Toadie, Susan goes to Paul for assistance. Paul agrees to investigate Peter Noonan and his findings and the subsequent article in the Erinsborough News are enough to convince the Council to sever ties with the development. The shopping centre development is off. But with his aims met, Pauls disinterested in fighting to save Toadie.

When Michael struggles with the paper shuffling involved in preparing for the new year as school principal, Emilia reminds him of the free-spirited, inspiring teacher he used to be. Michael needs to get away from the stifling paperwork so he convinces Emilia to come surfing with him, but in a strange twist of fate he ends up giving her a lesson on the front lawn.

Jade tries to compromise for Kyle but struggles, eventually cracking. Despite this, Kyle remains confident that one day soon Jade will want him to look after her, but fiercely independent Jade insists it will be a cold day in hell when that happens. However, when Jade injures her foot and is told not to move for a week, shes forced to face her worst nightmare relying on someone else.

Andrew busily prepares for the all-ages gig but Paul has his reservations. When Sophie learns Paul wont let her attend, she blackmails Andrew into persuading Paul to let her go. Andrew agrees to look after Sophie at the gig and the event proves to be a resounding success. However, when Andrew catches Sophie kissing an older boy, she threatens Andrews hard earned trust with his father.

Frustrated by the lack of progression by the police to find Chriss attacker, Lucas takes matters into his own hands. Putting together the pieces offered by Chris, Anna at the law firm and finally Kyle, Lucas believes Lewis could own a racing greyhound. He and Kyle discover there is indeed a Dasher running today and aware its a long shot, Lucas takes a punt Lewis will be there.

Determined to clear his name, Toadie takes a gamble and poses as Lewiss court-appointed lawyer. As Toadie hoped, Lewis fails to recognise him as the man he claimed to have hired him, clearing Toadies name. However, when Toadie returns to work, hes stunned to discover his job is still in doubt.

Toadie is told the firm is letting him go but with a very generous settlement. Sonyas pleased that this will allow them breathing space to find another job but Toadie suspects hes being bought. He refuses the settlement and lays down his terms - either they give him his job back or he takes them to court for unfair dismissal.

Still determined to earn a place in the surgery program, Rhys works to uncover his next targets weakness. When he discovers Erins vulnerable and recently on the rebound, he decides to pursue her romantically as a means to divert her attention from her studies. Seeing Erins not Rhyss type, Kate suspects hes up to no good.

With a plan to distract Erin by romancing her, Rhys sets up for their first date. Knowing shell be guarded, Rhys manipulates the date to bring her home with him with the intention to make her miss an important class the next morning. Although his plan appears to fail, Rhys is delighted when Erins lateness earns her an official warning.

Sophie continues seeing Corey, blackmailing Andrew to keep it from Paul. But when Kate spies Sophie on her date, she realises how much shes missing out about Sophies life. When she tries to find out more, she inadvertently alerts Paul to Sophies new boyfriend and embarrassed its something hes been unaware of, Paul confronts Sophie and grounds her.

Aidan gets his car serviced, and Lucas thinks he sees the first sparks of romance. Trying to discover whether Aidan is gay, Lucas embarrasses Chris but things get worse when George arrives. With a potential boyfriend in the wings, will Chris risk his fathers disapproval.

Playing down his interest in Aidan, Chris maintains it isnt worth ruining his mended relationship with George for this. Unconvinced, Tash sets Aidan and Chris up at the Australia Day BBQ. Fearing itll be awkward, Chris tries to bail but, when hes forced to talk to Aidan, realises hes cool and relaxes.

Rhyss plan appears to come unstuck when Erin ends their relationship, insisting she needs to focus on the program. Realising hell have to play dirtier to get what he wants, Rhys manipulates Karl by implying Erin has a drinking problem. However, when pressured Erin quits as a result, Rhyss guilt is piqued. Is he having second thoughts about what hes done.

Rhys fights his way into the surgical program, assuring Jessica he can prove himself by passing an entrance exam. But Karl wises up to Rhyss manipulation and confronts him threatening his potential future on the program. Desperate, Rhys opens up to Karl revealing what it is that drives him to be a surgeon.

Needing Sophie to continue seeing Corey in order to sign the band Red Cotton, Andrew encourages her. However, when Sophie realises Coreys not as cool as she thought and contemplates calling it off, Andrew fears his deal will sour. Desperate, he encourages Sophie to give Corey another chance but, when Summer learns of his manipulation, she challenges him to put his cousin ahead of business.

Emilia encourages Michael to be the free-wheeling teacher she remembers. Buoyed Michael agrees but soon finds himself stifled by Priyas rules. Defying Priyas new order, Michael resorts to his unique teaching approach. But is he about to be busted.

Reacting on instinct, Michael bins his lesson plans hell continue to teach the way he wants. However, when he tells Emilia what hes done, she comes up with a better plan to keep Priya off his back. To Michaels dismay, it involves breaking into the school to get his lesson plans. Are they about to get busted by Priya.

With Emilia failing to reciprocate his declaration of love, Lucas fears hes rushed things again, but Sonya reassures him. Confused Emilia seeks Michael out, unsure where they stand. However, after seeing Lucass investment in Emilia, Michael cant betray his best friend and claims he doesnt have feelings for her.

Realising shes lost her phone and everything on it, including a special photo of her and Sophie at the History Wall Kate tries to contact it, and is surprised when Dominic answers. Although wary, Kate arranges to meet to collect her phone but, when she gets lost and misses Dominic, she fears its gone for good.

Annoyed when Andrew refuses to let her work on Red Cottons music video, Sophie goes around him and asks Priya, who agrees on the condition that she gets her guardians consent. Sophie gathers up the courage to talk to Kate but is thrown to discover shes gone and nobody knows when shell be back. Feeling abandoned by her sister, Sophie acts out at the shoot, earning Priyas wrath.

Pauls furious about the stunt Sophie pulled but when he realises shes been destablised by Kates unexplained departure, his anger turns to concern. He appeals to Priya for leniency and she concedes she may be swayed if Sophie demonstrates remorse with a public apology.

With the stigma of Peter Noonan still hanging over him, Toadies desperate to prove himself to his new team at work. However, when the Babymaker program Sonya downloaded onto his laptop goes off during an important presentation, Toadies embarrassed.

Pauls caught off guard when Roz from the DHS arrives, looking for Kate to discuss Sophies expulsion. Enquiring whether Paul knows where Kate is, on the spot, Paul insists that Kates merely on holiday and that Sophies staying with him while Kates away. But when Roz arranges an interview with Sophie, Sophie refuses to lie, or do anything, to cover for Kate.

Desperate to bring Kate home in time for Sophies DHS hearing, Paul embarks on his search in Port Douglas. He manages to persuade the local chief of police to put out a missing persons report, but offends him in the process. Paul next hits one of the local bars to see if anyone recognises Kate, but is led up the garden path by an opportunist looking for a quick feed.

Despite her fears that Michael will remember she cheated, Summers reminded of her trouble with Andrew. Encouraged to mend things with him, Summer attends a Traffic Light Party with Tash, only for Andrew to arrive in orange indicating he might be available. And things only get worse when Michael confronts Summer revealing hes remembered everything and is going to report her cheating.

With Michael planning to report Summer for cheating, protective Andrew takes things into his own hands. He tracks down Michael and argues Summers case but Michael stands firm. Summer decides she cant sit back and do nothing. She interrupts Michael at school, desperate to talk him round.

With the ball left in her court, Summers torn over whether to come clean about her cheating. Andrew tries to persuade her to keep quiet but when Tash learns of Summers betrayal, its all too much and Summer decides its time to confess. With Susans encouragement, she turns herself in to Priya.

Hearing Pauls in Port Douglas, Kate fears the worst and calls Sophie, only to discover shes safe. Shaken, Kate impulsively comes down hard on Sophie for being expelled from school. Hurt by Kates tirade, Sophie makes it clear she no longer needs her for the DHS meeting, claiming Susans agreed to be her guardian. Kates stunned but glad shes okay.

Kate embraces her decision to go travelling with Dominic. They plan to spend a last day in Port Douglas together before heading off to Vietnam. But then an impassioned email arrives from Sophie the DHS will take her into foster care if Kate doesnt come back. Kate is forced to choose between her new boyfriend and their shared dreams of travel and her little sister back home.

When Susan discovers Sophies missing, Callum cant help but feel worried for his friend. When concerned Paul calls on Priya to gather information from Sophies class, Callum suspects Rani knows more than shes letting on. He follows Rani home, ambushing her in her bedroom and discovering Sophie hiding there.

Callum wrestles with keeping Sophies secret but, when Toadie unwittingly confirms Sophies fear shell be sent into foster care, he resolves to stay quiet. Losing hope that Kate will return, Callums buoyed when she finally does. Now confident her return will bring Sophie home, Callum reveals shes staying at Ranis and they make it to her in time.

Pauls confronted when Kate challenges him to take on legal guardianship of Sophie. Knowing he was previously denied guardianship of Harry, Paul argues the DHS wont agree with Kates plan, and privately fears hes unfit to raise a teenage girl. Seeing Paul doubt his parenting abilities, Andrew reminds him how far hes come as a father and convinces Paul to apply for guardianship.

Unable to stop thinking about Michael and their kiss, Emilia attempts to talk to him about their feelings for each other. However shes thwarted by an oblivious Lucas with a lunch invitation. Using Lous sudden arrival home as an excuse, Emilia escapes to find Michael and reveal her confused feelings.

Realising going back to school is the only way to get into her Journalism course, Summer resolves to repeat Year Twelve. Being a once renowned graduate, Summers confronted when she admits shes back in Year Twelve because she cheated, only to be taunted by younger students. Will Summer be able to tolerate the humiliation and the prospect of a yearlong grind, or will she crack it and quit.

When Sonya pushes more fertility remedies on Toadie, he feels like his masculinitys being questioned. Determined to prove hes a manly man, Toadie sets off on a quest to fix the hole in their wall, but ups the anti by insisting hes going to install a fireplace too. While Sonya worries Toadies overcompensating, its clear he has no idea what hes doing.

After officially becoming Sophies legal guardian, Paul thinks hes doing the right thing by enrolling her at Eden Hills Grammar, but when Sophie flatly refuses to even consider it, Paul sets out to get her reinstated at Erinsborough High.

Now that Sophie has made her home with Paul, Kate wonders whats keeping her in Ramsay Street, especially when Jade and Kyle have been keeping their distance from her. Jade notices Kates isolation and invites her to join the Boot Camp shed running for singles. Jade only does this because doesnt think Kate will be staying for long.

As Kate struggles with her newfound feelings for Kyle, she laments missing her chance with him a year ago. But when she learns that Kyle was prepared to fly to Port Douglas for her, Kate realises there may still be hope. But seeing how much Kyle and Jade mean to each other, just how far will Kate go to get what she wants.

Growing impatient, Michael approaches Emilia to see if shes decided whether she wants to be with him or not. While Emilia continues to bide her time, shes forced to turn to him for help when she finds herself stranded in the middle of nowhere. Michaels excited to play the hero but, when he finally gets to Emilia, the Sandman breaks down and hes awkwardly pushed to contact Lucas for help.

While Emilia and Michael agree to keep their relationship secret for now, Chris wrestles with what hes discovered. Concerned how Tash and Lucas will take the news, Chris confides in Aidan who encourages him to stay out of it. Chris sees how happy Tash is and realising her world will be rocked if this comes out the wrong way, confronts Michael.

Tash wrestles with the revelation that Michael and Emilia are together, realising she needs the full story first. Michael gives her a version of events - leaving out their illicit history - and Tash buys it. But, still confused, she seeks Chriss support.

Susan is excited about moving into her new flat. She busily throws herself into the final stages, giving Karl her blessing to see Jessica. But moving out of her home for fifteen years is harder than Susan expected. Initially daunted by the unpacking task ahead of her, Susan persists and her determination seems to pay off.

With Kates challenge weighing on his mind, Rhys considers trying to seduce Jade, just to prove he can. But, when he sees itd be far too complicated to come between his housemates, Rhys shuts the idea down. When Jade unwittingly stings him however, Rhys becomes determined to teach her a lesson, vowing to split her and Kyle up for his own reasons.

Michael and Emilia hold off on telling Lucas about their relationship, eager to enjoy the calm before the storm. But, when he mistakenly gets the impression that Emilias sticking around Erinsborough for him, Lucas remains hopeful of a romantic reunion. Eager to get back in her orbit, Lucas invites her to lunch.

Lucas confronts Michael, who admits the truth he and Emilia are together. Concerned that Lucas is likely to revert to type and take on some risk-taking behaviour, Chris tries to keep an eye on him but eventually Lucass treatment of him causes him to snap. He suggests Lucas stop taking it out on him and instead start confronting whats happened.

Determined to make her journalism dream a reality and prove Paul wrong, Summer searches for a story that will generate debate online enough to be reflected in newspaper sales. Discovering the local police station is getting closed down to make way for a community centre, she pitches the story to Paul, promising to show him how her skills work.

Desperate to secure financing for Red Cottons residency, Andrew sees Kate happily spending her trust fund and gets an idea. Despite Paul telling him to stop relying on handouts, Andrew asks Kate for a loan to set up his new venture.

Andrews worry grows when he learns ticket sales have slowed for Red Cottons gig at Charlies. Needing to drum up publicity, he contemplates asking Summer to use her new job at Erinsborough News to gain him publicity but decides against it until he feels pressure from Paul. Summers reluctant at first but, realising how much Andrews supported her, agrees to help.
Chris tries to make peace between Andrew and Summer, but even when Summer apologises, Andrew remains frosty. Are the cracks in Summer and Andrews relationship getting wider.

Wanting to show her support of Michael and Emilia, Tash offers to cook them dinner. Well aware of her own cooking limitations, Tash chooses to barbecue and, while she comes close to finding the remnants of Emilias secret, her aunt beats her to it and disposes of them for good.

While Michael deals with the fallout of Tashs actions, Tash seeks solace in Summer. Determined to explain himself, Michael reaches out to Tash, desperate to let her know he never meant to hurt anyone. At Summers behest, Tash hears him out but will she ever be able to forgive him Emilia assures Michael that Tash will come around but privately, they both fear theyve lost Tash for good.

When an old friend of Karls dies, Karl finds his new girlfriend Jessica is not as understanding as he would have liked. Instead, its Susan who understands, and its Susan who helps him get through the funeral when the grieving widow asks Karl to play a song in honour of his dead mate. What does this mean for Karls new relationship, and his old love.

Karl avoids telling Jessica about his night with Susan. But when she finds out for herself, she issues an ultimatum its her or Susan. Karl is torn, but realises he has too much history with Susan, and must end things with Jessica. But he still has to find a way to move on with his life independent of Susan.

Lucas is shocked when he finds out hes the main suspect in torching Michaels Sandman. When Chris finally manages to convince him its serious and he should talk to a lawyer, Lucas approaches Toadie. only to discover that Toadie doubts his innocence.

Seeing Michael devastated by Tashs rejection, he tries talking to Tash but is heartbroken when she makes it clear the only chance they have of reconciling is by leaving her alone. Knowing she has come between Michael and his daughter, Emilia sacrifices her love for them both and decides to leave town, hoping to give Michael a chance at rebuilding his relationship with Tash.

Spying an opportunity, Rhys causes tension between Jade and Kyle by convincing Kyle to propose they share a room more permanently. When Jade inevitably shuts down the idea, Kyles disappointed, worrying Jade. Helping Jade at her Singles Boot Camp, Rhys then uses the time alone with Jade to exacerbate her own fear that her issues will keep hurting Kyle.

Toadies efforts to remain relaxed are tested when Callum insists on cooking the first meal in their new kitchen. With some persuasion from Sonya, believing this could be a good way to continue their de-stressing, Toadie agrees. But after a series of disasters, of which the final straw is Toadie losing his keys down the incinerator, the plan to de-stress is derailed.

While Andrew prepares for Red Cottons first gig at Charlies, Summer tries to show her support by offering to review the gig and help generate publicity. But when Andrew refuses any help from her, Summer suspects somethings wrong. Checking with Chris, Summer is shocked to learn of Andrews reluctance to involve her in his work.

Seeing Andrew enjoying his success, Summer decides not to push him into resolving their issues, giving him space instead. While she worries about their relationship, shes somewhat buoyed when she receives her first pay cheque as a journalist. However Summers excitement is undermined when she sees Andrew dejected because he has to continue working at Lassiters to pay back Paul.

Toadie continues to enjoy the stress relief of work until he discovers Sonyas learned it was his choice to increase his workload. Once apologetic Toadie explains his reasoning to her, shes supportive. Having overheard Toadies confession, Callum tries to help out by organising tickets to the football, but Toadies is unaware and goes to work instead.

With Jade still refusing to forgive him for manipulating her, Rhys escapes the tension at home to visit his mother, Elaine. However when Elaine asks to spend Easter with him at the sharehouse Rhys is forced to lie and claim hes working.

Summer and Andrew are confronted when theyre forced to face each other for the first time since starting their break. Although they both resolve to push through their awkwardness to attend Tashs party, it becomes clear theyre on very different paths when they separately voice their contrasting expectations to their friends.

Fearing that he and Summer are about to break up for good, Andrew lets Belinda flirt with him at Tashs party. Summer struggles to deal with the reality of being around him without them being together, and ends up leaving the party. Karl sees that Summer is miserable without Andrew and encourages her to end their break.

Shocked by Andrews betrayal, Summer returns home. Andrew pleads for Summer to focus on the positives of their relationship and reunite. Summer tries to put Andrew kissing Belinda behind her, but cant. As much as it pains both her and Andrew, she insists theyre over.

Privately knowing hes at fault, Paul channels his guilt into anger and openly blames Ajay for the delayed police response time at Tashs party. Ajays determined to get to the bottom of why no police showed up when first called and his findings lead him to suspect there never was a first call.

Refusing to back down, Paul defends his actions when Susan threatens to reveal how far he went to bring down Ajay. However, privately fearing their consequences, Paul offers to right his wrongs by paying for neighbourhood damages. While Susan appreciates his efforts, she challenges him to fix the biggest mess hes made and restore Ajays reputation.

Seeing how much Summers job means to her, Susan holds onto Pauls secret. However, when she realises Summers continuing her investigation into the party, Susans forced to keep her off the scent for her own sake. Despite Susans veiled warnings, curious Summer pushes on and uncovers what Pauls done realising Susan knows about it but is keeping quiet.

With his role in Tashs party exposed, Paul vents his frustration by firing Summer. Despite the community outrage, Paul tries to stay strong but is rocked when both Andrew and Sophie turn on him as well. Finding hes not only lost community and personal support, but that his advertisers are now also dropping out, Paul resigns as editor to save the paper from going under.

Lucas continues to embrace his commitment-free life, and with an amused Rhys and Kate looking on he picks up an attractive girl at Charlies. But waiting at home for him is someone with news that will leave him rocked to the core.

Struggling to process Vanessas revelation, Lucas hits the road to escape the reality of becoming a father. However, when Lou encourages him to be wary of Vanessas intentions, scared Lucas sees his way out and pushes Vanessa away by questioning whether the child is his, intimating shes only after his money.

Unable to give up trying for a baby of their own, Toadie attempts to convince Sonya to reconsider, urging her not to let Lucass situation influence theirs. However Sonya stands firm, certain their struggles might jeopardise their current happiness. Toadie seeks advice from Karl who suggests IVF.

Discovering her house is already on the market, Tash realises shell need the job at Charlies to be able to afford to rent an apartment with Chris. However, when Tash realises shes in danger of losing the Charlies trial to Kate, she plays dirty, successfully putting Kate in Celestes firing line.

Still hurting from their decision to stop trying for a baby, Sonya distracts herself by caring for an injured baby wombat while Toadie leases a sports car to ease his disappointment. Knowing Callum has to be told, Toadie takes the pressure off Sonya by telling him theyve stopped trying.

Trying to ignore the possibility hes responsible for Vanessas pregnancy, Lucas is thrown when she turns up in Erinsborough, convinced shes back because of him. But when he discovers shes in fact the potential new chef at Lassiters, Lucas is threatened. Clutching at straws to keep her out of his life, Lucas drops the fact that shes pregnant to Paul, changing his mind about hiring her.

Feeling guilty about sabotaging Vanessas job opportunity, Lucas works hard to find a way to help her. Realising theres little he can do, Lucas accepts his helplessness. But, when he witnesses the extremity of Vanessas financial woes, hes confronted by her reality and attempts to reach out by offering her money.

Andrew gives Kyle some accounting software as a thank you present. But when they input all the figures from the books Lou has been keeping, they discover that Kyle is actually 8,000 in debt. Convinced Andrew has simply made a mistake, Kyle tries to take this in his stride. But Kate can see how important this is for him, so she approaches Lou.

Surprised and disappointed to discover that her staff lack initiative, Susan empowers them to be more proactive, unaware that Paul has planted a mole in her team to keep watch for him. Afraid that Susan will lose the advertisers he worked so hard to secure, Paul challenges his spy, Fiona, to gain access to Susans email.

Paul puts pressure on Susan by reminding her that now shes editor, her head will be the first to roll if there are any complaints. Susan pushes through her fatigue, insisting on overseeing every last detail. Worried, Karl reminds her of her need to look after her health.

Feeling low, Summer reluctantly attends Andrews Red Cotton gig and tries to push through the awkwardness of their new friendship. However, shes confronted when Griffin starts paying her attention. Tash encourages Summer to enjoy some innocent flirting, and Summer eventually lets herself go, approaching Griffin.

Feeling the pressure, Vanessa accepts a job at Harolds despite being over-qualified. Determined to make the best of things but increasingly affected by morning sickness, Vanessas grateful when Sonya arrives with her collection of pregnancy books.

Realising he should have gone to the hospital with Vanessa, Lucas is guilted further when Rhys has a go at him for abandoning the mother of his child. Lucas finally reaches out to Vanessa but when she realises Rhys lashed out at Lucas, she gives Rhys a serve for fighting her battles. However, she quickly forgives him, throwing Rhys and leaving him intrigued by the new woman in town.

Callum and Rani decide to turn the tables on Sophie by pretending they really are falling for each other, successfully making her uncomfortable. However, when she heads home and unwittingly lets Paul know whats going on, Paul calls Ajay in the hope of stirring the pot. Ajay arrives at Toadies house to find Callum and Rani alone together and hes not happy.

Chris encourages Tash to figure out what shes going to do about her living arrangements. Together they realise that, with one more housemate, they could afford to pay rent and the house wouldnt need to be sold. Chris initially approaches Aidan, but quickly accepts theyre not ready for that yet. But Aidan also reminds Chris he still needs to run the idea past his dad.

Sonya and Toadie make the most of their free afternoon, determined to spend the entire day lazing in bed. Needing supplies, Sonya heads to Harolds where she meets Lucas. Buoyed to see him supporting Vanessa, Sonya reaches out to her estranged friend, eager to put their conflict behind them.

Ecstatic to learn theyre having a baby, Sonya and Toadie vow to keep the news secret until the all-important 12-week scan. But both are practically bursting with the happy secret, and struggle to get their affairs in order while avoiding suspicion. They hit a hurdle when Callum protests the cancellation of their trip to Europe.

Kate prepares for her final stand-off against Tash for the job at Charlies. When Tash scores the job, Kate is ready to give up. She runs into Sheila and gets some sage advice, so decides to approach Celeste about the decision. Celeste, impressed, makes her the new manager of Charlies.

Determined to take care of herself, Vanessa declines Lucass offer to help her out for the day. However, when Rhys clocks her carrying heavy cooking equipment into the house, he refuses to take no for an answer. Genuinely intrigued by this woman, Rhys accepts Vanessas impromptu offer to show him how to bake.

After her recent MS relapse scare, Susans determined to maintain a healthy worklife balance. With some encouragement from Karl, Summer convinces Susan to ditch work and attend a yoga class. Susan enjoys the class, and Summer notices the instructor, Bernard, paying special attention to Susan. Susan plays it down, but, after the class, Bernard asks her out.

Andrew is annoyed to discover that Karls band have a gig at Charlies, assuming it will have a negative impact on Red Cottons residency. However Andrew is surprised when The Right Prescription turns a big profit. Not one to pass up a money-making opportunity, Andrew talks Karl into letting him manage the band.

With the tension between Summer and Andrew reaching a high, Chris decides not to celebrate his birthday. But Aidan, sick of Chris putting his friends needs before his own, is determined Chris will celebrate and decides to throw him a surprise party. Unbeknownst to Aidan, George has organised a big family barbecue, and insists Chris invite all his friends.

Chris, still scared of telling his father the truth, lies to Tash about inviting Aidan to his family birthday celebration. But Aidan finds out anyway. He appears at the celebration, but wont stay to let Chris explain.

Feeling on the outer with Callum and Rani, jealous Sophie invites the couple around to keep them in her orbit. However when she suspects their relationship isnt genuine, Sophie tests her theory with a game of truth or dare. Forcing their hand, Sophie dares a reluctant Rani and Callum to kiss, busting them when they awkwardly refuse.

Failing to engage any interest in his charity bachelor auction, Paul urges Kate to help his cause. Kate enlists Jade and together the friends successfully sell the auction idea to the single men of Erinsborough. Kate feels guilty about harbouring feelings for her friends boyfriend and resolves to move on from Kyle by snaring one of the bachelors.

Worried that Karl may get a higher bid than him at the bachelor auction, Rhys invites Vanessa along, and is pleased when she suggests shell bid on his behalf. As they prepare for the night out, Rhyss feelings for Vanessa grow. However, when Lucas sees Vanessa bidding a huge amount of money on Rhys, hes seriously suspicious about whats going on.

After a fantastic evening at the charity auction, Vanessa plays down the romance of the night to a concerned Lucas, but is clearly looking forward to spending more time with Rhys on their date. Scared shes setting herself up for hurt, Lucas attempts to warn Vanessa that Rhys cant be trusted, but she dismisses him.

Confused by Vanessas abrupt change of heart, Rhys confronts Lucas, suspecting he warned her off him. When Lucas admits he did but explains Vanessa didnt heed his advice, Rhys returns to Vanessa and learns that she rejected him because she saw him aggressively confront Susan.

Gearing up to tell Kyle how she feels about him, nervous Kate begins her date preparation early, but shes thwarted when Sophie arrives, needing homework help. Sophie questions why Kates going to such an effort for Kyle, suspicious that Kate might be making a play for her friends boyfriend. Kate insists shes not, but admits she does like Kyle.

Seeing Summer invest in her new romance with Griffin, Andrew works to secure his business with the band despite his tension with his ex. While hes buoyed when Griffin cooperates, Andrews hit for six when he catches him with another girl. Unable to stop himself, Andrew confronts Griffin, and is confused when Griffin insists he and Summer arent exclusive.

Andrew tries to warn Summer about Griffin, but is thwarted when she refuses to hear him out. Choosing to focus on his business instead, Andrew is thrown to discover The Right Prescription now doesnt have a bass player. Realising hes jeopardised his business by acting on an emotional whim, Andrew scrambles to find a replacement.

Shocked to discover that Troy is their new neighbour, Toadie vows he wont let him be part of Callums life. Worried about how to break the news to Sonya, Toadie asks Callum to let him handle it. But when Sonya comes home struggling after a hard day, Toadie decides not to tell her about Troy and tries to deal with the situation himself.

Returning home from their trip to Sydney, Jades more committed to Kyle than ever. But when she discovers Troys back and has asked Kyle to do some handyman work, she blasts Kyle, insisting everyone on the street should stay away from Troy. Kyle agrees but Jade immediately goes against her own words, visiting Troy and demanding he leave.

Lucass journey towards accepting fatherhood is cranked up a notch when Vanessa casually mentions shes having her first ultrasound for the baby. Wanting to involve himself, but unsure of how to do so, Lucas offers Vanessa a lift to her appointment. Vanessa sees this as merely practical support and insists she doesnt need it,

Unnerved by his presence as their doctor, Lucas accuses Rhys of manipulating the situation to make himself a part of Vanessas ultrasound. When Rhys backs down and leaves, Lucas is glad to get back to his special moment. However, unable to make anything of the ultrasound image, both Lucas and Vanessa feel underwhelmed.

Kyles helping Sheila to run a street party for the Queens Jubilee, but is upset when an increasingly distant Jade refuses to take part. Realising that Kyle and Jade arent in a good place and encouraged by Sheila, Kate sees an opportunity to tell Kyle how she feels.

Toadie and Sonya struggle to bottle up their stress and ignore Troy as he engages his new neighbours at the street party. When Callum arrives at the party and finds Troy there, he causes a scene and Toadie works hard to settle the situation. However, when Troy insists on talking things out with his son and refuses to leave, protective Toadie fires up and attacks him.

Terrified she could lose the baby, Toadie and Sonya rush to the hospital after her collapse. They learn all is well but the nightmare of Troys intervention order hangs over them. Jade realises that their only hope of stopping Troy lies in her hands.

Paul is keen to move things along romantically with Zoe and suggests they have a long lunch together. Before Zoe can agree, Sophie and Andrew crash their meeting. Andrew wants Sophie to play a one-off gig for The Right Prescription, but Sophie refuses on the grounds that it will damage her musical reputation. When Zoe sides with Sophies viewpoint, Sophie takes a strong shine to her.

Unsure what to do after dropping out of Contemporary Arts, Tash brushes off Karls well-meaning advice and heads into work. Embarrassed after mistakenly assuming that Ed, a nerdy customer, is trying to ask her out, Tash apologises and offers to help with the equation hes working on only to take offence when Ed dismisses her as just a ditzy waitress.

Disappointed when Jades unable to help him woo a client, desperate Kyle urges Kate to pretend theyre a couple to win him some much-needed business. Reluctant to get involved because of her feelings, Kate eventually agrees and convincingly plays the part of Kyles perfect partner, genuinely talking up his talents and winning him the lucrative contract.

Realising their kiss was a mistake, Kyle immediately shuts Kate down. Desperate to salvage his relationship, Kyle resolves to tell Jade the truth. However, she beats him to it and reveals her own secret that Troys her abusive ex. Kyles guilt is piqued as Jade apologises for being dishonest with him but, seeing her vulnerability, he resolves to keep his betrayal to himself.

Toadie leads his family into a mediation session, hoping Jades evidence about Troys violent past will win their case. Courageous Jade manages to put aside her fears and present her evidence, but Ajay argues there is no solid evidence implicating Troy. Furthermore, they intend to raise Sonyas violent history the time when she broke Jades arm.

Seeing Rhys flirting with Tiffany, Vanessa finally cracks and spontaneously invites him over for dinner. Rhys is nervous enough, and Vanessa does her best to give in to her attraction to him. But when Rhys has a strong, allergic reaction to one of the ingredients in the meal, he tries to cover it up, hoping not to blow his chances with Vanessa.

Pauls frustrated that, despite the success of his photo shoot, his image isnt yet rehabilitated enough to return him to the position of Editor. However, when Zoe presents him with a more likely way to improve his image, Paul stubbornly refuses it because it means caving in to Priya by making his once-promised donation to Erinsborough High.

Callum starts to secretly visit Troy on the condition that Troy will drop the case to ease the stress on Sonya and Toadie who remain oblivious to Callums plan. Rani, however starts to become suspicious of Callums whereabouts. When Rani catches him coming out of Troys house, Callum fears shell blow his deal and urges her to stay quiet.

Still struggling to accept Callums turnaround, Sonyas unsure how to tell Toadie that Callum now wants to see Troy. Knowing the stress could get to her, Karl suggests she hold off from telling Toadie. However, upon realising that Callums certain about this, Sonyas left with no choice but to break the news to heartbroken Toadie.

Enjoying her burgeoning romance with Rhys, Vanessas touched when he opens up about his father, so offers him a second date. Meanwhile, Lucas is confronted to learn that Tash is hosting a blackjack game and, with no-one to talk to about it, takes himself to a Gamblers Anonymous meeting.

Uncomfortable around Jade after her kiss with Kyle, Kate feels worse when Jade apologises to her for being distant. Unable to confide in any of her friends, troubled Kate finds herself empathising with Troy when she sees hes equally on the outer. Realising they have more in common than she had first thought, Kate finds the sounding board in Troy that she so desperately needs.

Callum continues to secretly visit Troy who promises to drop his Intervention Order against Toadie. When Sophie and Rani discover what Callums doing, they try to convince him to stop. Callum refuses and when he discovers Troys betrayed him, hes furious. Meanwhile Sonya learns of the deal Callum struck with Troy.

Callum is furious when he learns that Troy lied about dropping the intervention order against Toadie, and when Sonya discovers Callum has gone to confront Troy, she is horrified. She heads over to Troys place to ensure her son is safe. Sonyas concern grows when Troy refuses to open the door but Callum insists hes fine.

Thrown by Troys disappearance, Jade is convinced hes in hiding, readying to take revenge. But when Troy collapses in Lassiters Complex and is taken to hospital, Jade believes theyre safe, for now. But her relief is cut short, however, when the police arrive at the door. Troy made a statement before he lapsed into a coma, accusing Jade and Sonya of attacking him.

Jade works out Rhys relayed Troys accusations to the police and lashes out, unable to believe that he took Troys side. Feeling guilty, Rhys seeks comfort in Vanessa and is thrown when she sides with Jade. Frustrated after being kicked out of home, Rhys maintains that despite the consequence, he was right to give his patient a voice.

Worried about Toadie, Susan remains unaware of Pauls determination to reclaim his job as editor. Failing again to convince Zoe to help him, Paul gets desperate and orchestrates a meeting between Susan and Zoe, confident that theyll clash and Zoe will subsequently agree to help him.

Thrilled to win an award for her efforts at the paper, Summers convinced to host a celebratory dinner, but fears its too soon to invite Andrew. As she waits for Tash and Chris to arrive, Andrew surprisingly shows up to congratulate her.

Troy is beginning to stir and having flashbacks about Jade punching him and then tripping and the tool box landing on him. Karl seems satisfied with Troys immediate tests but says more will take place in the morning. He mentions that the police want a word too but Troy is having none of it, he wants to talk to his lawyer first even before any medical tests that Karl wants to do on him.

After being confronted by agitated Troy, Priya turns him away but warns Toadie and Sonya about the incident. Wanting their son safely home, they head to the school and discover Troys car is still there. Toadie goes looking for him as Priya and Sonya try not to let Callum and Rani know whats going on.

Rhys is furious when Karl tells him Troy has died, and had been allowed to walk out of the hospital despite his serious injuries. Karl defends himself and says he strongly advised Troy to stay, but Rhys is not satisfied, insisting Karl shouldnt have let Troy leave. A sombre Callum has flashbacks of Troy at the school, but when Toadie calls him he acts like everythings okay.

Seeing Toadie and Sonya in need of comfort, Susan steps up as a friend. However, when Paul pushes her to print an article about Troys death, shes torn between her duty to those she loves and her duty as editor. When Karl reminds her shes capable of doing both, Susan tries to write the article but finds it incredibly hard.

Finally in a good place with Jade, Kyle covers his unease when Jade insists on inviting Kate to brunch. Kyle escapes a close call when Keith, the client who believes Kate is his girlfriend, arrives at Charlies. His guilt is only further piqued when loved up Jade invites him to move into her room.

Kyles plans to tell Jade the truth are interrupted when she insists on supporting Sonya while Callum and Toadie attend Troys funeral. Needing an escape, the sisters take a trip down memory lane and rediscover their old selves in a time capsule at their grans house.

After hooking up with Andrew last week, Summers thoughts remain focused on him. Shes given hope when he seemingly sends her flowers, unaware theyre actually from Lyn. Chris tries to keep Summers expectations in check but, when Andrew invites her to Charlies for a drink, Summers hopes soar only to become confused when she sees Tash, Chris and Ed are there, too.

Lucas continues to enjoy being single but when he sees his chaotic romantic life has become tabloid fodder, hes forced to reassess his priorities. Upon being made to feel old by Andrew, Lucas queries whether Vanessa thinks his philandering is pathetic.

When Rhys invites her over for something special, Vanessa assumes its to spend their first night together. But shes thrown to discover its actually to meet his mother. Vanessa succeeds in making a good impression, however when Rhys seemingly rebuffs her advances once again, Vanessa fears her pregnancy is a turn off.

After being busted by Karl at the hospital, Vanessas disappointed when Rhys seems to give struggling Kyle the brush off. Upon learning of Jade and Kyles break-up, Vanessa challenges Rhys to help mend them, but he insists its not his place to get involved. Vanessa worries about Rhyss selfishness, but is pleasantly surprised when he reaches out and helps Kyle.

Upon hearing about the Ramsay House sale, Lucas assures Vanessa hell find them a home. However, when Paul suggests he should just buy the Ramsay House, Lucas is confronted by the idea of settling down.

Having excitedly invited his mother to attend their ultrasound, Toadies disappointed when Sonya asks they just share this moment. However, Toadies seriously disappointed when worried Sonya requests Callum doesnt come either.

Readying himself for Summers reaction to his article, Chris is annoyed when its clear Summer hasnt read it and remains oblivious to his frustrations. Quickly reaching boiling point, Chris confronts Summer and accuses her of being self-absorbed. Summers thrown by the attack and wonders if Chris has a point.

Kyle gets his hopes up after what he thinks is a moment of warmth with Jade, but after he sees hes misread the situation, hes disheartened. When Sheila arrives, she sees the break-up as a good thing, clearing the way for Kyle to get together with Kate.

Sheila convinces Kyle a big romantic gesture is needed to win back Jade. He leaves flowers at her house, with a card asking Jade to meet him to talk. But the plan backfires when Bossy gets to the flowers before Jade does. Angry Jade stands up Kyle, pushing him to chase her down at work with a final appeal. But after Jade rejects him yet again, he finally decides to move on with his life.

Jade continues trying to bury her feelings for Kyle. But her resolve is tested when she hears he told Sheila to leave town for interfering in their relationship. Shes further tested when Rhys tells her Kyles sick. Rhys calls Jade on hiding her true feelings, pointing out her pride is keeping them apart. Jades torn, however she finally invites Kyle to return home but only as housemates.

Rhys is excited to hear hes been nominated to go away with Martin on an overseas lecture tour. Showing theyre a great team, Vanessa uses her warmth and humour to help him complete his application. Just when it seems Rhyss career and love life are working in perfect sync, he learns the placement is for three months.

Tash and Andrew are excited in the lead-up to the launch of the app theyve created, until Ed discovers a glitch. Frustrated Andrew fears for the launch, but stubborn Ed insists itll be ready in time. Tension runs high as Andrew struggles to keep the launch afloat whilst Tash and Ed frantically battle to solve the problem. When they finally do, their celebrations lead to a near kiss.

Tash feels loyal to Ed after their near-kiss, but Andrew makes her see his socially awkward manner wont fly at their important interview. She invites Ed around to break the news, but shes thrown when he bites the bullet and asks her out. Pushing aside her growing feelings, Tash keeps Ed in the dark and insists shes got other plans.

Stung by the online response to the letter Chris published about their fight, Summer realises just how selfish shes been. After confiding in Karl, shes determined to right her wrongs. She starts small, firstly making tiny gestures of selflessness to Karl and Tash. But then she makes a bigger effort with Chris and uncharacteristically doesnt wait for his thanks.

Lucas is under pressure to find a place to buy or risk losing the chance to live with Vanessa. Lucas sees an opportunity when he learns the Williams House is going on the market. Unsure how Toadie and Sonya would feel about him buying Troys property, Lucas is reassured by Karl to go for it but is disappointed when his offer falls short.

Lucass shocked to learn Vanessa feels so strongly about what happened to Troy, she wont move in with him. Believing it stems from superstition, he tries to assuage her worries, but fails, not realising shes covering her real concerns. Lucas is driven to ask Rhys for help. Rhys offers little reassurance but his own interest is piqued.

Toadie is still reeling from being ditched as Sonyas birth coach. She wants a home birth he wants her to be as safe as possible. With some encouragement from friends, they find common ground Sonya will have a home birth, and a doula will look after them both. But when Sonya finds the perfect helper a wonderful person who just happens to be a very attractive man - Toadie is struggling again.

Andrew gets a generous offer from a casino wanting to buy the Odds On app but is frustrated when Tash refuses to go ahead with the deal. When the casino doubles its offer, Andrews faced with a dilemma betray a friend or earn his fathers pride.

Jades ecstatic to learn her Singles Boot Camp concept has been bought by interstate investors. Her instinct is to share her success with Kyle, but unable to let go of her hurt, she decides not to. Jades thrown when she comes home to a fitness themed surprise party. While Rhys claims he organised it, she sees the attention to detail and realises it was Kyles doing.

Kyle confronts Jade with her mis-sent text message, asking her to give their relationship another chance. Jade claims her message was just an excuse to avoid a date, but Kyle knows Jade still loves him, and urges her to try and move forward together.

Pauls plan to oust Susan is undone when she uncovers it before hes able to seal the deal with the advertisers. He scrambles to hold on, but when Susan threatens to take him down unless he steps aside, Zoe admits theres no way around her. Forced to give up his position of power, Paul takes his frustration out on Sophie and manages to offend her.

When Pauls reminded yet again of Sophies attachment to Zoe, he realises he needs to find a way out of this relationship fast. He resigns himself to taking his time, slowly easing Zoe out of both his and Sophies lives. But hes thwarted when Sophie invites Zoe to the Kapoors housewarming barbecue, forcing Paul to also attend, with Zoe on his arm.

Tash discovers the apps been taken offline, and Andrew claims it must be a glitch, assuring her hell look into it. Feeling guilty about making Andrews life hard with her opposition to the Casino Associations offer, Tash tries to help by investigating the apps disappearance herself, as well as organising a potential sales meeting with the State Government s office of gaming.

Unaware the house has been sold to The Kapoors, Lou returns from his trip to the UK and makes himself at home despite the unfamiliar surrounds. Lous presence goes unnoticed until the new owners mistake him for an intruder. Annoyed he wasnt told the news, Lou confronts Kate and learns Lucas has bought Number Thirty-Two.

Unsure how to deal with Lous betrayal, Kyle seeks advice from Jade. But confronted by discussing betrayal and forgiveness after their own recent troubles, she cant help him. So Kyle turns to Sheila for help. Loyal Sheilas adamant Lou deserves no forgiveness. But after considering it, Kyle decides everyone deserves a second chance. He forgives Lou.

Jade tries to gloss over her argument with Kyle but soon realises hes serious about his ultimatum. Still not ready to move past his kiss with Kate, she gets advice from Toadie, who reminds her what forgiveness truly means and that she doesnt have forever to make up her mind.

Under pressure with the schools latest budget, Priya proposes suspending the Kitchen Garden scheme and the VET course. She battles through the opposition of her neighbours but is surprised when Paul supports her at the board meeting. She loses the vote but forms an unlikely alliance with Paul over drinks at Charlies.

Toadies concerned hes been under extra scrutiny from Charlotte at the office lately. When he details Charlottes attitude to pregnant Sonya, she grows paranoid, worrying that Charlotte may be trying to hit on him. Despite initially dismissing this idea, Toadie eventually lets it get the better of him, especially when Charlotte invites him to a private meeting.

Faced with the prospect of Vanessa leaving tomorrow, Lucas is unable to hide his feelings any longer and Lou quickly guesses hes in love with her. Lou convinces him to tell Vanessa before she goes and Lucas arranges a farewell dinner for just the two of them. But his plans are thwarted when Vanessa invites Rhys to join them.

On the morning of his birthday Andrew anticipates finally receiving payment from the casino group. Gearing up to tell Tash the truth about the deal, he tries to make sure shes on her own so her reaction wont be influenced by anyone else. However, he walks into a surprise birthday lunch and, seeing the effort everyones gone to, Andrew decides the truth will have to wait.

On his way to see his mum before his long-awaited trip, Rhys drives past the teen car wreck. Seeing their lives hang in the balance, he tries desperately to help them - but manages to injure his hand in the process. Ignoring his pain, Rhys pushes on until the ambulance arrives.

Riddled with guilt, Chris makes no objection as hes questioned by police and his license is suspended. All his concern lies with Sophie. After Paul prods for information on what happened leading up to the crash, Chris breaks down with Susan, confessing how badly he messed up. Trying to make amends, Chris apologises to Paul but is stunned when Paul makes it clear hes suing him personally.

Lucas assures Chris Pauls anger will blow over. However, when Paul pulls a big contract - reminding Lucas of exactly how much he has to lose - Lucass concern deepens. Pleased to learn Vanessas sticking around, when hes confronted with her plans for the babys nursery, the reality of Pauls threat sinks in. Lucas is swayed when Lou points out that family should always come first.

As Lucas debates whether or not to accept Chriss resignation, isolated Chris goes to visit Sophie. Suspicious Paul discovers a gift he doesnt recognise, forcing Aidan to reveal its from Chris. Despite Kates attempts to talk him down, furious Paul hunts down Chris and publicly blasts him, banning him from visiting Sophie.

Andrew realises hes neglected Chris, the only friend who didnt ostracise him after the crash. But when Chris rejects his apology, angry at Andrew for not supporting him when he faced his criminal charges, Andrews left on his own. When Andrew starts experiencing disorientation and dizziness, he has no friends to turn to and tries to self-diagnose.

Ajays frustrated with the feeling hes going nowhere in his job now that his political dream is over. Priya encourages him to make the most out of his legal career, but when its banality weighs on him, ambitious Ajay realises he needs a new challenge. Surprised to learn there might be opportunities at Simmons and Colbert, Ajay takes Toadie up on his offer to introduce him to Charlotte.

Rhys is driving his housemates and his girlfriend crazy as he struggles to keep occupied while his hand heals. Finally, he begs Karl to find him some work at the hospital to keep him busy. But the ordinary work chores he finds himself doing just compound his sense of uselessness. Keen to help him out, Karl suggests bringing the tests on his injured hand forward.

As far as Rhys is concerned, his dream of being a surgeon is over. Vanessa steps up to support him, but is hurt when he pushes her away. Rhyss wallowing is cut short when hardline Susan steps in and challenges him to fight his condition instead of letting it control him. Defeated Rhys considers dismissing her, but he ultimately decides to put himself through the difficult process of rehab.

Convinced hes getting nowhere with rehab, Rhys loses heart. Having committed to seeing him through the process, canny Vanessa gets him cooking as a way to keep challenging himself. While hes awake to her scheme, charmed Rhys is happy to give it a go until he gets over-confident and attempts a task thats far too ambitious.

Keen to make a difference in someones life, Kyles stoked when Sonya and Toadie officially invite him to become godfather to their daughter. However, Kyles thrown when his cousin Harley turns up on the street - in a cop car. Learning that Harleys been caught acting out, Kyle reprimands his cousin and is confronted to learn this isnt the first time hes been in trouble with the law.

After committing to sorting out his wayward cousin, Kyle drags the reluctant teen down to the yard and puts him to work. Harley proves a tough nut to crack however and off Jades suggestion, Kyle agrees to give him some responsibility leaving the teen in charge of the yard in the hope hell step up. But Harley mucks up, ignoring the responsibility hes been given until he meets Callum.

Shunned by his friends, Andrew decides to look after himself and buy a new car. However, Paul encourages him to invest his money instead, offering to look at his proposals. Andrew throws himself into it, appreciative of his fathers support. But just as Andrews about to meet with Paul, he experiences another black out, this time waking up on the floor.

Scared Andrew heads to hospital to find out whats wrong with him and is diagnosed with epilepsy. Andrew goes into denial, ignoring instructions to tell his family. However, when Aidan allays Andrews fears that Paul will see him as weak, he prepares to tell his father only for Paul to suggest going into business together.

When Sophie admits she is feeling isolated in hospital, Chris takes the afternoon off to spend time with her. Seeing she needs more than just company, though, he and Aidan team up to raise her spirits by redecorating her hospital room. Reminded of the rapport, Chris asks Aidan to give their relationship another chance. Aidan declines, not convinced Chris is really ready to commit to him.

Even though his symptoms arent going away, Andrews forced to push on with his stressful work at Charlies. However, when he comes close to showing signs of his illness in public, he turns to Aidan for advice. But when Aidan informs him hell have to do an overnight hospital trial, Andrew fears Paul will find out and refuses.

Despite his struggle to control his epilepsy without medication, Andrew remains determined to prove himself a success in his fathers eyes. As Andrew prepares to host their first gig at Charlies, Aidan warns him to get treatment before its too late.

Lucas is concerned about Chriss chance of winning against Pauls civil suit when he learns that Chris is being represented by a suburban lawyer acting outside his area of expertise. When Lucas sees the lawyer is pre-occupied with other cases, he asks Toadie to take over Chriss defence. Toadies initially unsure, and when Ajay vetoes the idea, the matter is seemingly out of his hands.

Theres trouble in the share house when Harley gets on Rhyss nerves big time, but when Rhys is roped into playing video games with him, it looks like theyve finally found common ground. Rhys assumes Harley has his own console, and to Kyles surprise Harley brings one home. Kyles suspicious, but cant bring himself to accuse his cousin of stealing.

Kyles frustration grows when Harley refuses to admit he stole the money from Rhys. Jade volunteers to try and get through to Harley, insisting she just needs to find what he cares about. Jade initially fails to find anything, but eventually stumbles upon Harleys interest in Rani. Jade threatens to tell Ranis parents about his theft unless he confesses.

Confident hes rehabilitated his injured hand, Rhys is rattled when he faces a minor setback. Failing to stall the test, Rhys wills himself to succeed, but is frustrated when its seemingly out of his control. Needing to know if hes done enough, impatient Rhys sneaks a look at the results but is gutted to learn his hand hasnt improved and therefore wont.

Determined not to put lives in danger, Rhys manages to avoid assisting Jessica during a surgery, confident that with a bit more intensive, specialised therapy, hell be ready the next time. But when he keeps falling short, Rhys is shattered. Realising hes still got a long way to go and not wanting to raise any more suspicion, Rhys opts out of another surgery.

Suspicious about Rhyss recovery, Vanessa tests his injured hand and is dismayed when he fails. Rhys explains that the recovery is an ongoing process no-one expects him to be up to full speed at this point. Vanessas unsure whether to trust him, particularly after discovering how ruthless Rhys was when he originally chased a position on the surgery program.

When Toadie advises Chris he needs to get witness statements from all the passengers in the crash, Chris dreads asking Andrew, knowing he hasnt treated him well lately. But Chris is shocked when Andrew refuses to testify against his family. Chris vents to Aidan but Aidan avoids knocking Andrew, knowing how much stress Andrews under.

With Jade not wanting to make a big deal of her last night before she leaves for L. A. , Kyle plans a romantic evening just for them, unaware Sonyas organising a surprise celebration. Despite his final moments with Jade being hijacked, Kyle goes along with it, hopeful theyll get their own proper goodbye.

Priyas upset after she reads a negative article about her involvement in the VET debacle, and is disappointed when Ajay doesnt give her the support she needs. However, shes further frustrated when Paul goes in to bat for her, speaking on her behalf.

Guilt ridden Priya dedicates her time to her husband, but when shes unable to forget the spark that bad-boy Paul brings to her life, she puts herself back in his orbit. Faced with the reality of potentially engaging in an affair, Priya tries to backtrack. However, when Paul warns its inevitable something will happen between them, shes rattled.

Vanessa continues supporting Rhys through his rehab under the proviso he wont get involved in any surgeries until hes ready. However, when Jessica pulls him into an emergency situation, he goes along with it and manages to pull it off. While Rhys is confident this is a sign his hands improving, Vanessa is appalled by what hes done.

When Jessica stops him from assisting on the surgery, Rhys suspects Vanessa has spoken to her and is furious at her betrayal. Hes rocked when Jessica reveals hell have to re-sit the tests on his hand. Desperate to believe hes healing, Rhys insists on taking the tests as soon as possible, refusing to leave until it happens.

Andrew reluctantly agrees to attend Pauls civil case against Chris despite being troubled to learn that, if Chris loses, his family will be forced to sell their house. Andrew expresses his reservations to Paul but Paul isnt interested, expecting his sons continued support.

Determined to help Ed reach his potential, Tash ignores Summers warnings and secretly makes him over for the university ball. Validated when everyone seems to notice how well Ed scrubs up, Tash is happy her works paid off until Chris unwittingly foils her plan and Ed realises what shes done. He accuses her of being shallow and Tash is given pause for thought.

Summer impresses Bradley with her pitch for a story about a local paralympian. Hoping to be chosen as its writer, Summer buries herself in research but fumes when Bradley gives the story to his new drinking buddy. As Summer witnesses Bradleys relaxed approach to work, she worries hes not taking Erinsborough News seriously.

When Paul uses Lassiters potential participation in the V. E. T. Program as an excuse to spend time with Priya, she foils him by inviting Lucas, Sonya and Kate to join her on Pauls tour of the hotel. Finally finding time with her alone, Paul suggests she craves the excitement that he provides but Ajay cannot.

Determined to stay faithful, Priya avoids an awkward confrontation with Paul, choosing instead to go home with Ajay. However, shes thrown when Paul freezes her out and is disappointed when Paul insists hes done chasing her. Unable to get him out of her mind, Priyas incensed when Paul doesnt show up at a school board meeting unaware hes been innocently held up.

Wracked with guilt, Priya struggles to lie to Ajay about where shes been. Realising she left her jacket at Pauls house, she makes an excuse to accompany Rani when she visits Sophie. At the Robinson house, confronted by the reality of her adultery, Priya warns Paul it will never happen again and makes a hasty escape. She wavers when Paul insists he wants to keep seeing her in secret.

Confident his epilepsy is under control, Andrew focuses on making Charlies a success but Chris sees he misses Summer and Tash. Chris urges them to give Andrew a chance but while Tash refuses, Summers convinced to offer an olive branch, inviting Andrew to play soccer with them. Appreciative Andrew agrees but Aidan advises him against it, worried hell overexert himself.

Tash is left confused when Andrew refuses medical help and assures her hes fine, promising his fit was a one-off. Concerned Tash asks Aidan for advice and realises not only that this wasnt Andrews first fit but that he has epilepsy. Tash attempts to talk Andrew into seeking help but when he bluntly pushes her away, frustrated Tash washes her hands of him.

Summer tries to orchestrate more time with Bradley and is rewarded when Susan asks him to officially be Summers mentor. However Summers excitement grows even further when Bradley suggests they start by going to the trivia night together.

A worrying dream about Bradleys attraction to her forces Susan to realise she needs to put an end to it. However she struggles to find the courage to have the uncomfortable conversation until she discovers she doesnt need to because Bradleys seeing Summer. Conflicted Susan feels Bradley is way too old for Summer but is torn as to whether to say anything.

Vanessas uncharacteristically rattled by news of an unexpected visitor and works to get Lucas out of the house before their arrival. Her strange behaviour gives him cause for concern and he returns home to check on her. But hes stunned when he busts her with her mother Francesca and realises she doesnt know Vanessas pregnant.

Lucas works to convince Francesca hes good enough for her daughter, but she remains unimpressed. While he fears hes let Vanessa down, Sonya worries their act will lead him to a broken heart. Putting his needs first, Sonya urges him to step back and not get involved in Vanessas family problems.

Pauls on a high from the fun of his affair with Priya, however when he also takes delight in his rivalry with Ajay, he inadvertently piques her concern. She challenges him about his real reasons for pursuing her, and Paul honestly admits he loves the thrill of the chase. But adamant this is a game in which she has too much to lose, Priya calls an end to the affair.

Having given in to her feelings, Priya can no longer deny she craves the excitement and spontaneity Paul brings her. And she displays a more understanding attitude when she finds Rani making out with Harley - Priyas unexpected response to the situation takes her daughter by surprise. However, when she learns Ajay is going away for work shes fearful about how badly tempted she might be.

When Bradleys mistaken for Summers father, Summer becomes acutely aware of their age gap. Hoping to show Bradley shes not too young for him, embarrassed Summer shuns her immature friends and attempts to be more sophisticated. However when Bradley assures Summer he likes her and her friends just as they are, shes encouraged to lighten up and have fun.

Susan arrives at the office and Bradley covers for Summer, who stays hidden, claiming he tripped the alarm when he came in to work late. Susan buys the act, but when the story Bradley claimed to be working on doesnt show up in her inbox the next day, her suspicions are piqued.

Priya continues her affair with Paul, using a VET meeting at school as an excuse to meet up in private. However when Kate gets wind of their meeting, she interrupts it, keen to put forward her ideas. Her passion with Paul thwarted, Priyas frustration grows as theyre forced to sit through Kates pitch.

Paul runs into worried Ajay as he searches for Priya. While he manages to cover her whereabouts to Ajay, when he gets her alone he suggests she should be quick to think of an excuse. Priya scrambles to justify her absence, but when Ajay queries her strange behaviour, she hastily claims shes being secretive because she was consoling Susan.

When Paul catches Andrew accepting medication delivered to Charlies, Tash covers for him by claiming its hers. With nothing planned for her nineteenth birthday tomorrow, Tash is open to Chriss suggestion of a hot tub party but Rhys quickly shuts down the idea.

Stoked Kyle doesnt question it when Jade returns home early and dismisses Rhyss suspicions there might be something more to her surprise visit. However when he realises Jades being evasive, Kyle starts to think Rhys might be right.

While Jades convinced Kyles on board with her news, Kyle struggles to come to terms with what it means for their relationship. He considers following Jade to L. A, but quickly realises he cant leave his life behind. Inspired by Georgias take on a long distance relationship, Kyle invests in the idea.

Rocked by Kyles unexpected break-up, Jade clings to the hope it was a rash decision. Confronting him, shes frustrated to find hes more resolved than ever that this is their only option. Venting to Sonya, Jades thrown when her sister urges Jade to see things from Kyles perspective.

Keen to distract herself from Jades departure, Sonya focuses on her baby shower. Despite a shaky start to the event, Sonyas buoyed when she overcomes awkwardness with Vanessa and Francesca and everyone starts to have fun. However this is disrupted when Toadies old friend Connor unexpectedly arrives.

Vanessas thrown when Francesca organises for her parish priest to meet with she and Lucas. Determined to appear compatible to earn the priests blessing, Vanessa and Lucas start memorising details about each other. But theyre surprised when the priest is more interested in their commitment to the future.

With her relationship going from strength to strength, Summers thrown when she learns Bradleys accepted a new job interstate. Assuming this means theyre breaking up, Summers buoyed when she misreads Bradley and thinks he wants her to come with him. Weighing up whether to leave Erinsborough, Summer ultimately decides shes ready to broaden her horizons.

Summer shocks Susan when she hands in her resignation. Aware of Bradleys sordid past, Susan tries to convince her to reconsider, without telling her the ugly truth. But when Summer sticks to her decision, Susans forced to intervene. Summers confused by Susans revelation and tries to get onto Bradley so he can explain himself.

Caught between Paul and Ajay, Priya struggles to handle what shes going through on her own. Protective Ajay suspects Priyas overwhelmed because Susan keeps turning to her for support, and asks Susan to give his wife some space. Confused but certain Priyas hiding something, concerned Susan pushes Priya to confide in her.

Tash clocks Andrew under pressure from Paul and volunteers to help him make Melbourne Cup celebrations at Charlies a success. Working together, they ensure the event is a triumph, satisfying Paul. However the day takes a nasty turn when Andrew suffers an epileptic fit and confronted Tash is forced to watch on, feeling scared and helpless.

Andrew finally resolves to do the right thing and secretly books himself in for extensive medical tests to determine how to best manage his epilepsy. Supportive Tash works to keep Paul off the scent but she unintentionally pushes him back to Andrew when he wants to share a congratulatory drink with his hard-working son.

Panicked Paul berates Andrew for endangering his life by keeping his illness secret, sending him straight to hospital for the clinical tests. But just as Andrew feared, he takes Charlies away from him too. Pauls anger simmers until Tash gives him a wake-up call, pointing out Paul put so much pressure on Andrew, he didnt feel he could tell him the truth.

Susans surprised when her sister Carmel arrives. Recently separated, Carmel suggests they try speed dating. When Karl shows up for the speed dating as well, the situation gets awkward for Susan but Carmel and Karl have a great time. Attracted to him despite her better judgment, will Carmel fall for her sisters ex.

Lucass hopes for the wedding are threatened when he discovers Rhys plans to attend. Confronting him, Lucas urges Rhys not to be there, reminding him what Vanessa stands to lose if he gets in the way. Rhys is unfazed but when he sees Vanessa and Francescas bond, he reconsiders his plan.

The pressure on Vanessa builds in the lead-up to her wedding day. But, unaware Rhys plans to attend, Vanessa commits to going through with it. Lucass nerves remain, but when Rhys appears to be a no show, he finally starts to relax only for Rhyss late arrival to throw both him and Vanessa. Fearing hes come to derail the ceremony, Lucass relieved when Rhys keeps his peace.

Priyas torn when Ajay plans a family Diwali celebration, forcing her to postpone her rendezvous with Paul. Priyas surprised when Ajays love, spontaneity and reminiscences of the past rekindle her feelings for her husband. Caught in the moment with Ajay, Priya forgets about Paul, leaving him waiting. And when she finally arrives, she reveals shes only come to end their affair once and for all.

Gutted that Priyas ended their affair, Paul resolves to win her back when Andrew unwittingly encourages him not to give up. However Pauls confronted when Priya accuses him of trying to entice her back just because he hates losing. Paul considers her accusation, but when he realises he cares too much about Priya to let her go, Paul lays his heart on the line.

Still uneasy about Lucass feelings for her, Vanessa keeps her distance until shes forced to put her reservations aside to celebrate Sonya and Toadies engagement. However when Lucas makes a heartfelt and romantic speech for his friends, Vanessa softens and starts to see him in a new light. And shes reminded of how much hes done for her, without ever asking for anything in return.

Still uneasy about Lucass feelings for her, Vanessa keeps her distance until shes forced to put her reservations aside to celebrate Sonya and Toadies engagement. However when Lucas makes a heartfelt and romantic speech for his friends, Vanessa softens and starts to see him in a new light. And shes reminded of how much hes done for her, without ever asking for anything in return.

Georgias on a warning from Karl and to teach her the importance of accurate paperwork he gives her the job of cleaning up incomplete patients files. Keen to keep her job, she diligently attacks the task but in the process discovers that Aidan has set up a fake file for Andrews blood test. She confronts him and Aidan pleads for understanding he did it to save Andrews life.

Aidans frustrated when Karl passes his case onto the hospital board but downplays the potential outcome when Chris expresses his concern. When Chris learns Aidan was protecting Andrew, he blames Andrew for putting Aidan in this situation. Believing Summer and Tash will stand against Andrew, Chris is gutted when they side with Andrew.

Unable to track down Aidan, Chris grows increasingly worried, concerned about his state. However when Chris finally finds him the next day, Aidan insists all he needed was one night to blow off steam. But when Rhys assures Chris it takes more than a night to get over what Aidans been through and Aidan seemingly confirms that by wanting to go out again, Chriss concerns resurface.

With Tash finished exams and Summer having quit her job at the Erinsborough News, Karl worries the girls are at a loose end and need a distraction. Carmel comes to the rescue, suggesting they keep busy by volunteering at the Community Christmas Appeal. Unaware of Carmels ulterior motive to spend time with him, Karl attends as well.

Rhys struggles to move on from Vanessa. Hes unable to listen to Elaine talking about how good they were for each other, or handle seeing Vanessa with Lucas. But hes confronted when Kate suggests he needs to put aside his fear and fight for Vanessa. Weighing up the messages from Elaine and Kate, Rhys re-evaluates how he treated Vanessa and decides to apologise to her.

Concerned Chris wants to do all he can to support his suspended boyfriend and books him a meeting with the hospital advocate. Frustrated by Chris getting involved, Aidan cancels the appointment but keen to get Chris off his back, claims he went. Confident hes done the right thing by Aidan, Chris is confused to discover Aidan never showed.

Hopeful his dad will see his condition is continuing to improve, Andrews frustrated when Paul shuts down the idea of him returning to Charlies. Feeling he has no choice, Andrew returns to running the bar remotely through Tash until Paul catches them out and is furious Andrew cant be trusted.

Realising he needs to let his son live his life, Paul reinstates Andrew at Charlies. Learning Tash was integral to Pauls turnaround, grateful Andrew shows his appreciation but the moment is interrupted when Nick, an important bar critic, arrives to review Charlies. Andrew and Tash work together to win Nick over until he gets too familiar with Tash.

Rani returns home and spying Priya wearing what seems to be her old earrings, she assumes theyre not her mothers and breathes a sigh of relief. However when she discovers theyre new and from Ajay, her fears are confirmed somehow, Priyas earrings turned up in a Lassiters hotel room.

When Priya learns Ranis taken off with Harley to a party across town, her concern escalates and shes driven to inform Ajay. Fortunately Ajay finds his daughter, but hes floored when she announces her mother had an affair with Paul. Passing it off as Ranis way of diverting from her own trouble, Ajay dismisses it.

Devastated Priya struggles to cope with the fallout of her affair, thrown when Ajay insists on knowing the details. Priya tiptoes around her betrayal but is eventually forced to admit it wasnt a one-off and it was because she was unhappy in their marriage. Priya refuses Pauls offer of sanctuary and commits to another lonely night in her office, determined to keep punishing herself.

When Karl learns of Ajays marriage problems, he offers to cancel their Christmas performance at the Community Centre. But Carmel insists Ajay could use the distraction and convinces Karl to encourage Ajay to play. Karl soon regrets his decision after Ajays forced to cross with Paul but hes relieved when Ranis surprise attendance leaves Ajay buoyed.

Still overdue, Vanessas frustrated when she learns Sonyas gone into labour before her. Trying to provide her with a distraction, Lucas suggests he photograph the final moments of her pregnancy. Vanessas reluctant but she and Lucas share a moment when he genuinely compliments her beauty.

Rhys rushes panicked Vanessa to hospital. Still unable to get on to Lucas, Rhys realises how terrified Vanessa is of giving birth alone and promises to stay by her side. Meanwhile, Lucas works to convince Francesca that Vanessa really needs her, completely unaware shes already gone into labour.

Toadie arrives with Sonya at the hospital as she is rushed off to theatre. Toadie's shattered by the drama of Nell's birth, while Callum works hard to look after his Dad. Toadie's relieved to hear Sonya's out of surgery but when Karl can't confirm the health of the baby, Toadie's worst fears resurface.

Shattered Toadie fears the worst as Sonya remains in surgery. However he's so lost in his own pain, he's oblivious to Callum's upset until Susan urges him to pull himself together and be there for his son. Toadie steps up for Callum, and puts on a bright façade to support him through the ordeal. And thankfully, Sonya finally pulls through.

Ajay's surprised Rani seems to be coping in the wake of Priya's absence.
