On the morning of the Lassiters pigeon race, Piper is devastated to discover that Clementine has eaten two of the three pigeons Karls and Toadies with only Garys surviving. Terese guesses that Paul did it and vows to make the race day a success. Karl is upset about the loss of his investment but Toadie is more easygoing.

Though she tries to run, Steph is captured by the fanatical and unbalanced Ari, who has brought his snakes to the Brennan house. He ties Steph up and proceeds to set the scene in a desire to ritualistically take care of unfinished business with her. He is determined to avenge the wrongs done to Belinda - his great love - and believes that snakes only bite those who are evil.

Its the night before Paiges first professional boxing match, and shes devastated to learn her parents wont be coming along to watch the event. Lauren and Brad assure Paige explain that they cant bring themselves to watch her potentially getting hurt. Its a blow to Paige, but when Jack offers his sympathy, she pushes him away, knowing he disapproves of the fight as well.

Paige struggles in her first pro fight, but the support of Brad and Tyler helps her rally and she lands a lucky blow that knocks her opponent, Angelina, out cold. At first Paige is triumphant, but when it becomes clear that Angelina may be seriously injured, guilt sets in. She refuses to leave the hospital until Karl can tell her whats going on, but the news isnt good.

Paige reels in the wake of Angelinas prognosis. Jack finds her at her thinking place the bus stop and offers his support. She decides to go and visit Angelina at the hospital, talk to her, like she did to him when he was in a coma. But at the hospital, Paige is confronted when Angelinas mum unleashes her grief, blaming Paige for Angelinas predicament.

Amy returns from visiting Nene, determined to face Kyle. Protective Paul tells her she doesnt owe him anything but Amy insists shes doing it for herself she refuses to be a coward. She struggles to engage with Kyle, but when he opens up to her about the problems hes having with Georgia, Amys interest is piqued.

Upset after Neds vitriolic outburst at the trivia event, Elly wonders if their relationship is doomed. Meanwhile, Lauren sees a freaked out Ned outside the Waterhole. When she approaches him he shakes her off. He returns later to apologise and Lauren presses him to tell her whats going on. Finally, after weeks of secrecy, Ned finds himself unburdening.

Susan cautions Sonya about her plans to help Mark and Steph out. Toadie is left reeling by Sonya's thoughts, feeling blindsided, and Sonya wonders what this will mean for their marriage. Will Toadie take on her idea – or reject it out of hand?

Toadie dwells on Sonya's proposal, tracking down Karl to get his perspective. Karl encourages Toadie to see it as an act of love on Sonya's part. After seeing an incredibly upset Steph pining for her child, Toadie meets Sonya to tell her his decision.

Xanthe is flat as Ben and Madison prepare for their trip to the Gold Coast, resigned to her fate. But when Madison suggests Gary is a pretty soft touch and tells Xanthe to give her search for permission another go, Xanthe decides she's going to the Gold Coast whether the adults like it or not.

Ben and Madison have arrived on the Gold Coast, but Ben can't help but miss Xanthe – until she unexpectedly shows up to be with him. Xanthe tells Ben she's ready to go all the way, but the moment is interrupted by another surprise arrival.

Steph tracks down Ned to tell him that she knows he was the one who had an affair with Jacka's wife Regan, and that it's only a matter of time before Jacka does too. Ned is terrified, sending him into the arms of Elly.
With Jacka knowing about his affair with Regan, Steph tells Ned that he needs to leave town. Ned is reluctant – he needs to be here for Brad's wedding, leaving him having to make a hard choice.

A mortified David convinces Amy to call Dr Kennedy instead of security when she catches him snooping around where he shouldn't be. Despite his actions, Karl is ready to give David support when he learns that the young doctor is searching medical records to uncover a mysterious piece of his past.

Finally in agreement about the surrogacy, Toadie and Sonya nervously prepare to talk to Steph and Mark about it. While Steph and Mark are at first shocked, they then have to decide whether they want to take Sonya and Toadie up on the offer.

Ned returns in time for Brad's buck's party, and admits to Brad that he took Regan to Albury, figuring it wasn't safe to leave her here with Jacka seeking revenge. Brad warns him that Elly knows – she saw him leave with Regan – and now Ned needs to face Elly's wrath.

An upset Terese is disappointed to learn that the police can do nothing and that Jacka is able to walk free. Terese then turns to Paul, who finds, when made aware of how shaken and vulnerable Terese is, his true feelings for her beginning to resurface.

On hearing Leo's on the lookout for work, besotted Aaron suggests he scope out a job with Lassiters. Leo elicits an introduction to boss Terese in exchange for organising the group outing with Amy and David at The Back Lane Bar. When the foursome gathers, Aaron lavishes Leo with attention – until it becomes apparent that Leo's interest lies elsewhere.

Poor Piper. Her birthday has been forgotten by her family and close friends. The only comfort she gets is from Clementine's cuddles, until Tyler shows up with a present and a plan. He whisks her off to an undisclosed location, where some intimate contact reignites the spark between them.

Steph prepares to meet Adam, the son she gave up at birth. While a nervous Steph waits for the moment she can set eyes on Adam for the first time, Toadie and Sonya are confused by her decision to keep the meeting from Mark.

Its the night of Laurens hens celebration and everyones in high spirits as they frock up in their costumes until Brad and Lauren find a goodbye note from Ned, announcing hes left town for their safety.

Lauren gathers with Paige, Piper and Elly for the second part of her hen's celebration: a hot air ballooning adventure. Tensions run high as an unexpected guest joins the flight, but another shock is in store when the main burner goes out. As everyone in Erinsborough races to meet the descending balloon - who will survive Jacka's revenge?

As help descends upon the balloon crash site, three lives hang in the balance - leading Jack to finally confess his true feelings for Paige and leaving Karl forced to take drastic measures to ensure the survival of one of the wounded.

Already feeling guilty, Karl worries about whether he made the right decision at the site of the balloon crash. While Susan tries to reassure him, Karl is forced to admit the situation is more serious than she thinks: was it malpractice?

Mark is reluctant to leave Steph's side as she recovers in hospital. Knowing he could have lost her, Mark's priorities shift and he takes time off work to be with her, but will it also change his attitude towards the potential of surrogacy?

Gary arrives late for Family Feud training following Sheila witnessing a terse exchange between him and Terese. While Xanthe is annoyed at his lack of focus, Sheila implores Gary to defend himself against Terese, with neither being aware of the true nature of Gary's relationship with her. With the countdown to the studio on, will the tension within the Canning family boil over on screen?

Survey says... it's time for Family Feud! Reeling from the news Gary's mystery woman is Terese, the Cannings are bickering amongst themselves as the cameras roll and host Grant Denyer introduces them to the rest of Australia. How can this possibly end well?

Humiliated after David's rejection, Amy reluctantly seeks some perspective from Leo. Amy's pleasantly surprised by Leo's loyalty and softens to him… but still totally unaware of the bet that Leo has made with Elly.

It's a big day for Sonya, Toadie, Mark and Steph, as they face their first interview with their fertility doctor Victoria, who takes them through the preliminary questions around surrogacy. Though they are mostly on the same page, secrets are kept and views begin to diverge - and the foursome are forced to face the fact that this process is more complex and confronting than they first thought.

Brad's health continues to deteriorate and a lurking Nurse Eve recommends Lauren get a second opinion, but David's insight inadvertently helps Eve's witch-hunt of Karl – especially when the investigation into Regan's death still hangs over his head.
Tyler's determined to make a final decision about him and Piper, but her annoyance as he mulls over his choice leads her to make a surprising turn to someone else…

Xanthes overcome with emotion as her mother Brooke arrives at the Canning house. While Brooke tries to explain her disappearance to a heartbroken Xanthe, she begs Gary to try and convince Xanthe to give her a second chance... will she get it?

David tracks down the man he believes to be his father, but the skittish Bradley Satchwell panics and attacks him. When they wind up in hospital with nowhere to escape, will David finally get the truth he's been looking for?
While Leo is surprisingly hit hard by Bradley's disappearance from the hospital, David tracks down his ex-wife – who reveals that Bradley's past bears a striking resemblance to Leo's present.

Lauren is alarmed when Brad talks about his time being up and begs Karl for help, not realising the seriousness of his own crisis of confidence. Despite this, Karl returns from leave to solve Brads case with a new urgency.

Halloween starts badly for Mark, with Steph refusing to discuss her decision to end their relationship over her poor fertility news, and he has no choice but to leave her to cool off – leaving Toadie and a surprisingly supportive Paul to help her come to her senses.

When the news of Sonyas surrogacy hits the front page of the West Waratah Star, the whole street reacts. Sonya is convinced this is the doing of Tim Collins hes trying to put pressure on her to resign as Mayor. But that knowledge still doesnt stop Sonya from making a snap decision that may have consequences.

A guilty Tyler tells Simone that he plans to confess his involvement to the police regarding the stolen car but she convinces him otherwise, offering to take the rap for the theft instead. What exactly is Simone up to?

When Paige finds out about Simone taking the blame for Tyler's car crash, she starts to wonder whether Simone's problems run a lot deeper than just pursuing an ex-love and tries to pull Jack out of her mind games.

Feeling the full effects of the IVF hormone treatment, Steph struggles to keep her emotions under control and despite Mark trying his best, he constantly does the wrong thing. How are Steph and Mark going to get through this rough patch?

Lauren is caught by surprise when Lou and Kathy arrive from Brisbane at the same time and are seemingly at odds. When tensions finally erupt over the dinner table, Lauren presses her mum and dad to stop lying and tell her the truth. Why are they suddenly fighting?
Its egg collection day for Steph and Mark and everyone is nervous. While everyone tries to manage their expectations they are rocked by a shock that changes everything.

Emotionally drained, Steph and Mark return from hospital having received crippling news regarding their possible future as a family. Mark quietly sinks into ever deeper internal conflict until someone makes a surprising offer.

Mark is willing to consider Sonyas offer of donating an egg as well as being the surrogate, but hes not sure how Steph will react. Also concerned about Toadie, Sonya suggests that they keep quiet about the idea until the right moment arises, but the decision is soon taken out of their hands.
Jack is gutted by the graffitied message on the Blaze Outreach building. Paige is determined to help him figure out who did it, but their investigation ends up pointing to an unexpected individual.
Elly is alarmed by a late-night call from an intoxicated Angus and, feeling partly responsible, sets out to bring him home before he comes to harm – but will Angus misinterpret Elly's intentions?

Paul uses the information about Maxines identity to force Terese out of the Mens Shed tender, but his victory is short lived... by the determined Leo, who has been biding his time until the right moment.

Xanthes warnings are unable to stop Gary from rekindling his relationship with Brooke, and as Brookes influence continues to spread, Xanthe is forced to turn to someone outside Erinsborough in order to save her father.

Sonya tests herself and discovers shes ovulating. The potential surrogacy has the perfect window of opportunity if they dont act now, they will have to wait. But in the haste to take advantage of the timing, it means not everyones cards are on the table.

Elly is torn when she receives a text out of the blue from her ex Derek, wanting to catch up. Hopeful, she gives Derek a chance and he proceeds to say all the right things, leading Elly to make him an offer.

Sticking to her plan to encourage Xanthe to leave town, Brooke drives a wedge between her daughter and Ben. However, Sheilas bond with Xanthe proves much more difficult to break, leading Brooke to take some drastic action.

Steph is beginning to feel sidelined in her relationship with Mark, coming to believe that the surrogacy is a bad idea. She drops her bombshell on a disappointed Mark and then approaches Sonya with an impossible request.

Asserting her desire to pull out of the surrogacy arrangement, Steph has asked Sonya to take the morning after pill to end the first cycle. Sonya resists and emotions run high as the two women reach an impasse. Steph turns to Mark for his support in ending the surrogacy – but is he on board?
Tragedy strikes the Tanaka family, and David takes out his grief on someone not expecting it.
Paul is intrigued by Nezumi, a mysterious tender for the Mens Shed. When he discovers Leo is behind it, a devious plan is uncovered.

Face-to-face with her ex, and needing to save her relationship with her daughter, Brooke pays her ex the money she owes him, then sits down for a heart-to-heart with Xanthe... will she finally be honest.
Sheila, Gary and Xanthe learn the extent of Brookes deception and are floored, hurt and disillusioned. Despite this, the Cannings present a united front and make Brooke an offer.

The Cannings have no choice but to come clean to the neighbours about the faux-jewelry scam. Although some of the neighbours are sympathetic to the situation - it looks like there may be some tension growing between the Cannings and the Kennedys.
Its the day of the big wedding and everyone is excited. With Susan as celebrant, the happy couple come dancing down the aisle.
At Lauren and Brads wedding reception, the newlyweds are on cloud nine until Maxine shows up... the marriage is off to a tumultuous start.
Sonya reveals her pregnancy to Toadie, while Piper and Tyler struggle with Tereses disapproval. Paige seeks solace in a surprising offer, while Steph and Mark worry about how shell react to the news.

Sonya discovers Toadies secret while Piper plans a dinner to get her parents on side with her and Tyler. Leo begs Amy for a second chance, while David inadvertently brings them together in an awkward situation.

Steph is feeling on the outer in the surrogacy arrangement with Mark and Sonya, while Piper and Tyler make a huge decision after a confrontation. Amy discovers she cant trust Leo, confirming her worst fears.
Brad and Terese search for Piper and Tyler, while Elly secretly plans to leave Erinsborough. Terese considers taking things further with Paul, and Susan plays an anniversary prank.
Leo partners up with a powerful ally to take on Paul and Terese, Sonya begins to bond with the baby, and a Ramsay Street cricket match risks family war.
Gary turns to an old friend to pay back his debts, Steph finds an unlikely confidante, and Paige and Davids fun night out ends with an emergency.
Mark and Ned try to track down Tyler and Piper, while Steph is tempted by another woman and David and Paige draw closer after a scare at the night club.

Tyler and Piper return to Erinsborough and tensions rise between the extended Willis-Turner family. Tyler worries about his job, while Elly and Neds URST sizzles in the heat. Will Paige drop the baby bomb.

Paiges pregnancy bombshell causes shockwaves in the family, while Garys pride pushes him to a bad decision. Aaron and Amys friendship is threatened when Aaron takes a job with Leo, and Piper worries Tyler may be the babys father.
Sonya and Toadie are interrupted by a shocking figure from the past, Gary gets in over his head, and Xanthe challenges Ben to a dodgeball game.

Dee Bliss returns to Ramsay Street after being presumed dead for years, causing shock and division among the residents. Toadie and Sonya are rocked by her reappearance, while Mark questions the truth of her story. Steph struggles with Marks protectiveness towards Sonya.
Toadie and Dee reacquaint themselves while the neighbours grapple with Dees reappearance. Leo launches his backpackers business, while Sonya fears Dee has come to Erinsborough to win Toadie back.
Paige finds a fake baby daddy, Toadie grows closer to Dee, and Mark and Steph are dishonest with each other, leading to a day of intimate encounters with other people.

In Episode 7524 of Neighbours, Leo is frazzled in the lead up to the opening of the backpackers, but a shock kidnapping occurs. Paige decides to take her babys surprise fake father up on his offer, while Piper and Tyler spend quality time together.

Paiges surprise announcement of a new baby daddy leaves Brad and Lauren with questions, while Leo devises a plan to avenge himself on Terese. Amy must decide if she trusts her father, and Piper and Tyler find a haven.

Sonya and Dee, ex-wife and husbands current wife, are feeling the strain of their relationship. Mark suspects someone is hiding in Dees motel room, while Steph and Victoria share a kiss. Tension builds as the two women battle for the affections of their husband.

Toadie receives a life-changing shock, Mark and Stephs relationship is pushed to its limits, and Susan and Sheila disgracefully lose control. Dee worries her presence is driving a wedge between Toadie and Sonya, while Steph comes clean to Mark about her feelings for Victoria and doubts about the baby.

Toadie and Sonya grapple with Dees bombshell while Mark and Stephs relationship is rocked to the core. Ben and Xanthe defy family battle lines for love, and attempt to bring about a reconciliation between Susan and Sheila.

Toadie discusses his donation with Sheila, Shane, and Kirsha, and Finn and Susan discuss Finns future plans. Karl is excited about the tram being installed, but Toadie cancels the fundraiser due to low attendance.

Roxy revealed she had won money through race-fixing in Darwin and wanted to get out of the mess. Chloe promised Roxy she was a vault for secrets, but Roxy saw her receive sneaky cash from Paul.

Meanwhile, Ned meets an unknown sender to discuss Finn, and Toadie prepares for the foundation launch to honor Sonyas memory.

Susan and Mark respond to a gas leak at the Lassiters Complex, where they find Toadie, Aaron, and Nell unharmed. Karl helps Bea, who is taken to the hospital, and Clive updates Gary and Amy that Sheila is conscious. Elly receives a call from Susan and Finn assures her that Dean wont bother her again.

Chloe feels guilty for telling Gary about Kyles true feelings, potentially ruining their friendship. Leo and Roxy discuss plans for the Back Lane Bar, while David and Aaron move their relationship forward. Paul and Terese argue about his meddling in Amy and Garys relationship, and Vance visits the Back Lane Bar. Roxy wants Vance to come for dinner to meet everyone, but he is reluctant.

Vance arrives at Number 22 and meets Terese, who is shocked to see him. They have a private conversation, and Ned interrupts them. Finn visits Harry in prison with Karl, and everyone has dinner. Ned is charged at the police station, and Terese tells Paul about Vances criminal past. Paul is worried about Leo, and Vance tries to stir things up by talking about love and family.

Elly, Mark, Aaron, and Susan investigate Finns past and discover that he was involved in a gas attack. They work together to protect Finn from the consequences of his actions and help him regain his memory.
